name: pg_sift
abstract: Columnar analytics and exact BM25 full-text search inside PostgreSQL — add an index or column table, keep your SQL.
description: pg_sift adds a columnar index (sift_col), a native columnar table access method (sift_table), a SIMD-vectorized aggregate engine (SiftAgg), and exact BM25 full-text search (sift) inside PostgreSQL with one CREATE EXTENSION and no extra servers.

pg_sift.abstract: Columnar analytics, column tables, and BM25 full-text search for PostgreSQL
